companies.name: ロング・ポイント・リーIV

relations.text: 巨大災害への備えとして、同社と再保険契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Long Point Re IV provides catastrophe protection to the Company through an indemnity reinsurance agreement

source.label: Travelers Companies 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: The Company has catastrophe protection through an indemnity reinsurance agreement with Long Point Re IV Ltd. (Long Point Re IV), an independent Bermuda company registered as a special purpose insurer under the Bermuda Insurance Act of 1978 and related regulations.

companies.name: フィデリス・インシュアランス・ホールディングス

relations.text: 2026年分の割合再保険契約を更新し、同社が保険料の一部を引き受ける
relations.text_en: The Company renewed its quota share reinsurance agreement with Fidelis subsidiaries for 2026

source.label: Travelers Companies 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Effective January 1, 2026, the Company renewed a quota share reinsurance agreement with subsidiaries of Fidelis Insurance Holdings Limited (Fidelis) for 2026 pursuant to which the Company assumes 20% of the subject gross written premiums of Fidelis on a risk-attaching basis, subject to a loss ratio cap.

companies.name: ジュント・ホールディング・ブラジル

relations.text: ブラジルの保証保険事業を担う合弁会社で、同社が49.5%を保有する
relations.text_en: Junto is the Brazilian surety joint venture in which the Company owns 49.5%

source.label: Travelers Companies 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: The Company owns 49.5% of Junto, a market leader in surety coverages in Brazil.
